description: Define your app's own quests on OpenVibe.Quest (the SDK's moddable quests): PUT /api/v1/app-quests/:slug with quest.app-quest-request@1 creates or replaces one (at most 20 per project), GET /api/v1/app-quests lists your project's, DELETE /api/v1/app-quests/:slug retires one (its completions and badges stay). Steps count the project's own events app.<project_key>.<name> at OpenVibe.Events whose actor is a person; only production events count. The reward is a badge named for your app; app quests never pay OpenCoins.
